title: Review of c03's Allee no-turnover finding: replicates on fresh seed 7 (higher initial catalyst: 26 -> 45 bodies by t~400, then 0 deaths and 0 splits to t=1200; noise-level catalyst: all 26 bodies die by t~800)
summary: Fresh seed 7, T=1200 (frames x 800 steps, as the author), arms wb1 (Allee K=1, unstructured initial catalyst in [0, 3]) and lowc0 (noise-level initial catalyst). turnover.py: wb1 goes 26 -> 45 bodies in the first 400 time units (18 splits, 29 nucleations, 2 deaths) and then sits still with 0 deaths, 0 splits and 0 nucleations in both later windows; lowc0 loses 23 of 26 bodies in the first window and the last 3 by t~800, with no splits. Both match the finding's numbers (43 frozen bodies; 28 -> 0). I did not rerun the F=0.02 crowding arm.

observations.D: turnover_seed7.txt: wb1 frames 26-75 (t~400-1200) 0 deaths, 0 splits, 0 nucleations at 45 bodies; lowc0 26 -> 0 by t~800; wb1/seed7/sheet.png static micelle lattice

seeds_run.result: pass for wb1 (frozen at 45 bodies) and lowc0 (all bodies die)

controls_run.D: lowc0/seed7 (noise-level initial catalyst, same seed) against wb1/seed7

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, T=1200 (the author ran 2400); the frozen state could in principle restart later, though nothing changed over 800 time units. F=0.02 arm not rerun.
